notes.monorepo: No root package.json — api/ (NestJS) and mobile/ (Expo/React Native) are independent sub-projects, each with their own Jest + tsconfig. Coverage enforcement is scoped to api/ only.
notes.testing_policy: Per explicit user direction: implement functionality first, write/run unit tests only afterward as a separate step. Tests must mock the DB/Prisma layer — never connect to the real Supabase/Postgres instance (a prior RLS test run mutated live data).
